name: O'Rourke's Diner
closed_reason: Closed in June 2023 and listed for sale as of October 2024 (Wikipedia, read Oct 2026); the 1946 diner car has not reopened.

name: Buford's Family Restaurant
closed_reason: Longtime (60+ years, several owners) diner-style family restaurant; announced closing on August 30, 2026.

name: Skippers Seafood (Old Saybrook)
closed_reason: Closed November 9, 2025; owners converting the space to EOS Greek Bowls & Pitas. The Niantic Skippers stays open.

name: Ford's Lobster
closed_reason: Left its Noank (Groton) location after its lease ended; the address is now Haring's Noank (open 2026). Ford's own site, still up in 2026, says it will reopen at a new location in 'Spring 2024', and no 2025–26 source shows it reopened. Sister restaurant Ford's Black & Blue (65 Marsh Rd, Noank) is separate.
